text:
maria: AM async — quick rundown: what I did / blockers / today

- did: landed prefetch fallback (abc123) and pushed a warmup job to canary; ran a focused kv-warmup + batch perf harness for model-x q8.
- blocker: seeing a p99 tail spike when batch=8 on a100 after the fallback change (~+30% in p99 for some runs). need help correlating slot-steal + kv-evict traces.
- today: iterate on slot sizing, open PR for a temporary throttle, and collect per-shard kv hit/histograms to share.

sam: can you paste the bench command and the rough numbers?

maria: sure — ran:```
bench/harness --model=model-x --tokens=512 --batch=8 --runs=120 --trace=kv,slots
```
results (median/tail): `latency_p50=45ms p95=180ms p99=277ms` — before change p99 was ~212ms. observed a handful of outliers tied to eviction spikes.

harry: saw the same class of regressions in my local run. I suspect the eviction window getting a bit aggressive on small-seq workloads. KV hit-rate drops from ~0.74 -> 0.59 during the microburst.

maria: added the histogram snapshot to a gist: https://go.gist/rdw-kv-hist-3789 (json) — shows per-shard hotset shifting at ~t=55s when slot handoff happens.

lee: +1 on eviction tuning. Also pinged reviewers on your PR #5142, left a couple tiny nits. Might be worth a canary flag to disable continuous batching for a subset of traffic to see if batching interaction is the cause.

ci-bot: perf-regression: kernel-prefetch-suite: FAILED on job 2026-09-14T08:04 (regression > 10% p99). Details: https://ci.redwood/tests/5372

sam: i'll take a look after standup at ~11:30. If we can reproduce with `--trace=slots,kv` we should get the handoff trace. maria, can you re-run with `--slot-debug` enabled?

maria: will re-run with slot-debug and a narrower time window. quick check — toggled flag `runtime.experimental.disable_continuous_batching=true` on canary and reran: p99 dropped to ~225ms (still above baseline but much better).

harry: good signal. i'll prototype a softer eviction policy (decay + grace window) and push a draft today.

lee: re: throttling small requests — i can add a traffic-shaper rule to the canary route so we avoid microbursts for 15m while we test. anyone object?

sam: nope, go ahead. also let's capture kernel traces for both routes (throttled vs normal).

maria: thanks — i'll collect traces and post results in this thread. if we see sustained improvement i'll open an ops ticket to roll the throttle for an hour in prod to gather more data. :thumbsup:

harry: no blockers from my side after today's patch, will coordinate reviews.

ci-bot: note: nightly regression job requeued with slot-debug enabled as requested.

maria: closing loop — re-ran 3x with slot-debug + slot-throttle; attaching quick summary below (short):
- baseline: p99=212ms
- after fallback change (no throttle): p99=277ms
- fallback + disable continuous batching: p99=225ms
- fallback + disable continuous batching + slot-throttle: p99=198ms

maria: next steps: file follow-ups (eviction tuning, slot-default sizing, canary throttle window), PRs for eviction soft-decay, and a postmortem note if we need to roll further.

lee: perfect. i'll stand up the short throttle window later and coordinate with infra on the canary.

sam: thanks team, i'll dig into the traces at 11:30 and follow up with a proposed mitigation.

maria: thanks — will update here with the exact PR links and final bench artifacts.
